subject: nereid-v8-hourglass
q: Four women miss the new envelope, and three of them miss it by almost nothing.
detail:
THE ARCHIVE RAN ALL THIRTY-TWO MEASURED WOMEN AGAINST THE PROPOSED LAW. Twenty-eight pass. Four do not, and the four fail for two completely different reasons.

ABBI — 38–26–44. Her separation is fine at 0.0933. HER WHR IS 0.5909, BELOW THE FLOOR, and she is the only woman in the canon outside the envelope on ratio alone now that Bella is corrected. Hips to 42 fixes it cleanly: 0.6190, separation 0.0652, EXTREME. Waist to 28 does NOT — it lands 0.1005 and fails by five ten-thousandths, which is a beautiful demonstration of why the unrounded figure is the one that counts.

IVY and JADE — both 36–26–42, both at separation 0.1032. THEY MISS BY THIRTY-TWO TEN-THOUSANDTHS. A two-inch bust brings either to 0.0652.

PANDORA — 34–26–42, separation 0.1457, the only genuine miss of the three. Bust 38 brings her to 0.0652.

THE ARCHIVE IS PROPOSING NOTHING. Every one of those fixes is a woman's body and every one of them belongs in a consultation, not in a spreadsheet — the proposal says so itself, in the clause about unauthorized arithmetic. What is recorded here is WHERE THE LAW AND THE ROSTER DISAGREE, and by how much.
